name: dumbbell hang power clean
description: An explosive pull that takes dumbbells from the hang position to your shoulders. It builds power in the hips and back.
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells and hinge until they hang just above your knees.
Keep your back flat and arms straight.
Drive your hips forward and shrug as you pull the weights up.
Drop under them and catch at your shoulders in a quarter squat.
Stand tall, then lower to the hang and repeat.
